plugins.name: chatlytics
plugins.description: WhatsApp messaging for Claude Code via Chatlytics — 10 MCP tools (send, read, search, dispatch, login, actions, directory, health, poll, configure) + a skill + passive WhatsApp inbox (background daemon + skills: /whatsapp, /reply-whatsapp, /send-whatsapp, /react-whatsapp). v2.5 auto-starts a background long-poll daemon on session launch so inbound messages surface passively on your next prompt.
